task.title: Fail closed on extension selection kind mismatch
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/615 by validating that caller-selected exact IDs all match one expected capability kind.
acceptance_criteria: Return an immutable selection only when every requested record has the expected ExtensionKind.
Reject wrong-kind IDs with a typed source-free error containing exact ID, expected kind, and actual kind.
Preserve empty success, duplicate and absent-ID rejection, borrowed records, and exact-ID ordering.
Report the first deterministic error with duplicates preceding sorted lookup and kind validation.

attempts.summary: Established RED coverage for kind-constrained registry selection.
attempts.diagnostic: The registry had generic selection and post-selection projection but no fail-closed API or typed mismatch error for one expected capability kind.
attempts.patch: Added tests requiring select_kind, KindMismatch details, matching and empty success, duplicate and absent behavior, ordering, precedence, and source-free errors.

attempts.diagnostic: Validating each resolved record in sorted exact-ID order prevents a routing mismatch from becoming a silent omission.
attempts.patch: Added ExtensionRegistry::select_kind, ExtensionSelectionError::KindMismatch, error formatting, docs, and milestone evidence.

attempts.summary: Refactored generic and constrained selection through one resolver.
attempts.diagnostic: Separate duplicate and lookup implementations could drift and violate the existing deterministic error contract.
attempts.patch: Introduced one private optional-kind resolver shared by select and select_kind and retained focused behavior coverage.

outcome.summary: Vela now fails closed when exact-ID enablement intent is routed toward the wrong validated capability kind, without crossing activation or permission boundaries.

verification.command: RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --locked in the pinned Nix environment
GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30189862802 and substantive exact-head CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/616

lessons: Fail-closed kind validation prevents a caller routing error from becoming a silent filtered omission.
Typed mismatch errors should preserve exact identity and both sides of the expected-versus-actual contract.
Explicit error precedence makes equivalent invalid input deterministic regardless of request order.
Generic and constrained selection should share resolution logic so identity semantics cannot diverge.
